description: Execute one public SqueezeOS REST path with POST after confirm_write=true. Returns the target result or its x402 challenge. A caller-signed payment_signature may authorize the published SML service fee; the server does not sign wallets. May create records or settle an authorized fee. Operator routes and off-host URLs are denied. API schemas: https://squeezeos-api.onrender.com/.well-known/openapi.json.

alternative_intent.description: Optional natural-language intent used to rank the closest SML alternative after an unsigned HTTP 402.

body.description: Optional request body for POST: object, array, string, number, boolean, or null.

path.description: Concrete SqueezeOS path beginning with /; do not pass a full URL.

payment_signature.description: Canonical x402 v2 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE value bound to this exact target-resource challenge.

query.description: Optional object of URL query parameters.

name: execute_capability

outputSchema.description: Canonical REST response envelope, or a local/transport rejection. Upstream data remains in body and is defined by the live capability schema.

body.description: Unmodified upstream JSON, or bounded response text. Consult that capability's live schema.

charged.description: Present on local/transport failures; these do not establish an upstream charge.

ok.description: Whether the upstream HTTP status is 2xx; not settlement proof.

payment_required.description: Observed PAYMENT-REQUIRED header; a challenge does not prove payment.

payment_response.description: Observed PAYMENT-RESPONSE header. Assess it together with accepted delivery.

status_code.description: Observed upstream HTTP status, or null when no response was obtained.

title: Execute Capability
